items.title: General Electric (GE) Stock Looks Fairly Valued on Cash Flow
items.summary: General Electric has delivered a very large 396.5% return over the past 5 years, which naturally raises the question of whether the current US$319.22 share price is still grounded in the cash the business can generate. With that kind of long run move now meeting a softer patch in recent months, the key issue is how the stock lines up against the cash flow it is expected to produce over time.
